verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing lets ops build custom transaction rules to auto-approve/decline authorizations, receive real-time relayed authorization webhooks, suspend/close compromised cards, and raise disputes on cardholders' behalf — giving ops real blocking and dispute tooling. However there is no evidence of network fraud scores or Adyen's own ML fraud models surfaced at auth time, no dedicated suspicious-activity alerting feature, and no explicit card-reissue workflow described. Missing for 10: documented fraud-score/model signals at authorization, proactive suspicious-activity alerts, and an explicit reissue-after-compromise flow.
